paragraphs.zh: 十二月，哥本哈根下雪了。天很阴，路上没有人。
paragraphs.en: In December it snowed in Copenhagen. The sky was grey and there was nobody on the streets.

paragraphs.zh: 我穿了很多衣服，出去跑步。
paragraphs.en: I put on lots of clothes and went out running.

paragraphs.zh: 雪很白，路很长。我跑得不快，可是我非常高兴。
paragraphs.en: The snow was white and the road was long. I wasn't running fast, but I was really happy.

paragraphs.zh: 我跑了五公里，然后回家喝了一杯牛奶。
paragraphs.en: I ran five kilometres, then went home and had a glass of milk.

paragraphs.zh: 女朋友给我打电话。她笑着说：“你太爱跑步了！下次多穿点衣服！”
paragraphs.en: My girlfriend called me. She laughed: "You love running too much! Wear more clothes next time!"
